statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-41179 affects rclone's RC HTTP endpoint operations/fsinfo, which can be abused for unauthenticated local command execution via attacker-controlled WebDAV backend bearer_token_command. Telegraf vendors github.com/rclone/rclone for the outputs/remotefile plugin and only imports rclone/fs, rclone/fs/fspath, rclone/vfs, rclone/vfs/vfscommon, and the local/s3/sftp backends. It does not import rclone/fs/rc and never starts the RC HTTP server, so the vulnerable endpoint is not reachable in this image.
